remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS DEADLINE IS SUNDAY at 3PM! Opportunity Knocks! Offered for the first time in over 50 years, this charming property presents a rare opportunity in the heart of Downtown Stamford. Ideally located within walking distance to shopping, restaurants, entertainment, and all that vibrant downtown living has to offer, the home is tucked away on a quiet dead-end street for a peaceful residential setting. Zoned for multifamily use, the property offers exciting possibilities for investors, developers, or buyers looking to create a unique single-family residence. Vintage character and period details remain throughout, including hardwood floors, while natural gas and a flat, deep lot add to the property's potential. The home is in need of TLC and offers a wonderful canvas for bringing your vision into the 21st century. Whether you're looking to restore its original charm, create a beautiful single-family home, or explore its investment potential, this is an opportunity not to be missed. Bring your ideas and imagination-this property is ready for its next chapter! House is being sold "AS IS".
